seed: Byron’s master board, Organizational Function Chart, Q4; Shannon Byrne Susko, 7 Systems One Pager, April 2026.

slides.title: Is your Team View still right?
slides.support: In Metronome: open Team View. Check it against the Function Chart you just agreed on.
body: Which functions are missing or planned?
notes: Put today’s Team View on the screen. Resolve any difference in ownership now.
Entering the agreed chart in the Team View can be homework. Give it an owner and a date.
A person who owns several functions carries a load to watch. A planned function shows where the company will hire or where someone can grow.
Ask the CEO in private: does an A-Player own every function? Use a break or the next coach and CEO call. Never ask it of the room.
A function owned by someone below A needs a plan. The A-Player check follows the KFFM.
slides.headline: Is your Team View still right?

slides.title: Are your scorecard reviews done?
body: Have you reviewed each of your direct reports against their scorecard?
If you report to someone, have they reviewed you against yours?
notes: Annual reviews on the function scorecards in Metronome were Q3 homework.
A review is a conversation against the scorecard. It covers the purpose, the accountabilities, the two metrics, the competencies and the Core Values.
This is a check, not a discussion of anyone’s review. Take the dates and move on.
Allow about 40 minutes for the scorecard, KFFM and A-Player checks together.
slides.headline: Are your scorecard reviews done?
